name: SE Handover – Client Site Guide, Site Passport & Renewal Reminders
author: stridedge

sections.description:
Every agency and freelancer hits the same three problems after launching a client site:

  1. “How do I edit the homepage again?” — the same support questions, forever.
  2. “Who hosts our site? Where’s the domain registered?” — nobody remembers a year later.
  3. “Our website is down!” — because a domain, SSL certificate or premium licence quietly expired.

SE Handover solves all three in one lightweight plugin.

Site Guide

  • A friendly “Site Guide” page in the client’s dashboard, with your logo, welcome message and contact details.
  • Write guides with the block editor. Five starter guides are included so you’re never starting from zero.
  • Instant search, plus a “Help” button in the admin bar.
  • Export your guides as JSON and import them on your next client site — write them once, reuse forever.

Site Passport

  • Automatically collects the facts: WordPress, PHP and database versions, theme, active plugins (with what each one does and pending updates), key pages, administrators, users by role, content counts.
  • Add hosting provider, registrar, DNS and backup details.
  • Detects the SSL certificate’s issuer and expiry date automatically.
  • One click produces a clean, branded handover document — print it or save it as PDF.
  • Never stores or displays passwords — by design.

Renewal reminders

  • Track domains, hosting, licences and any other service with a renewal date, cost and who pays.
  • Email reminders at 30, 14, 7 and 1 days, on the day, and when overdue — to you, your client, or both.
  • A dashboard widget shows what needs attention.

Built to be simple

  • No accounts, no external services, no tracking. Everything stays in your WordPress database.
  • White-label friendly: rename the menu to anything you like.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Site Handover → Settings and add your logo and contact details.
  3. Fill in Hosting & domain and add your Renewals.
  4. Edit the starter guides under Site Handover → Manage guides.
  5. Open Site Passport → Print / Save as PDF and send the document to your client.
sections.faq:
Does it store passwords?

No. SE Handover deliberately records where things are (hosting provider, login URLs), never the credentials. Use a password manager for those.

Who can see what?

Anyone who can edit posts sees the Site Guide. Only administrators see the Site Passport, settings and renewals, and only administrators can write guides.

Reminder emails aren’t arriving.

Use “Send test reminder” on the Renewals tab. If it fails, your server can’t send mail — install an SMTP plugin.

How is the SSL expiry detected?

The plugin connects to your own domain on port 443 once every 12 hours and reads the certificate’s expiry date. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. SE Handover Pro adds an agency dashboard for all your client sites, white-label branding, monthly client reports and a library of ready-written guides. The free plugin stays fully featured on its own.

Can developers extend it?

Yes. Filters: sehandover_passport_data, sehandover_renewal_items, sehandover_reminder_email, sehandover_email_footer, sehandover_print_footer, sehandover_settings_tabs, sehandover_is_pro, sehandover_show_review_request. Actions: sehandover_guide_before, sehandover_passport_after, sehandover_print_head, sehandover_print_after, sehandover_dashboard_widget_end, sehandover_tools_tab, sehandover_settings_tab_{tab}, sehandover_guides_imported. Guides can be imported in code with SEHandover_Guides::import( $guides ).
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New: a one-time request for a WordPress.org review, shown only to the admin who printed a handover document, at least a week after install, on SE Handover’s own screens. “Maybe later” hides it for 30 days; “Don’t ask again” hides it for good. Never shown when SE Handover Pro is active. Developers can turn it off with the sehandover_show_review_request filter.

1.2.1

  • Fixed: Print / Save as PDF, Refresh SSL, Send test reminder, and guide export and import did nothing in 1.2.0. Please update.

1.2.0

  • Changed: all code names now use the unique “sehandover” prefix (functions, classes, hooks, options). Existing data is moved automatically.
  • Changed: the admin menu now sits after the core WordPress menus.

1.1.0

  • New: developer hooks to extend the Site Guide, Site Passport, printed document, reminder emails, dashboard widget and settings tabs.
  • New: SEHandover_Guides::import() to import guides in code.
  • New: link to SE Handover Pro on the Plugins screen and Import / export tab (hidden when Pro is active).

1.0.0

  • First release.
